pdf_script = '''import pymupdf
from docx import Document

# Read the DOCX file
doc = Document("/workspace/testbed/docs/customer_report.docx")

# Create a new PDF
pdf = pymupdf.open()

# Page settings
width, height = 595, 842  # A4
margin = 50
usable_width = width - 2 * margin
y_pos = margin
page = pdf.new_page(width=width, height=height)

# Font sizes
title_size = 16
subtitle_size = 13
body_size = 10

for para in doc.paragraphs:
    text = para.text.strip()
    if not text:
        y_pos += 8
        continue

    # Determine style
    style_name = para.style.name if para.style else ""
    if "Title" in style_name or "Heading 1" in style_name:
        fontsize = title_size
        fontname = "helv"
        color = (0.1, 0.1, 0.4)
        spacing_after = 12
    elif "Heading" in style_name or "Subtitle" in style_name:
        fontsize = subtitle_size
        fontname = "helv"
        color = (0.2, 0.2, 0.2)
        spacing_after = 8
    else:
        fontsize = body_size
        fontname = "helv"
        color = (0, 0, 0)
        spacing_after = 4

    # Check if we need a new page
    if y_pos + fontsize + spacing_after > height - margin:
        page = pdf.new_page(width=width, height=height)
        y_pos = margin

    # Insert text with word wrapping
    lines = []
    words = text.split()
    current_line = ""
    for word in words:
        test_line = current_line + (" " if current_line else "") + word
        # Approximate character width
        char_width = fontsize * 0.5
        if len(test_line) * char_width > usable_width:
            if current_line:
                lines.append(current_line)
            current_line = word
        else:
            current_line = test_line
    if current_line:
        lines.append(current_line)

    for line in lines:
        if y_pos + fontsize > height - margin:
            page = pdf.new_page(width=width, height=height)
            y_pos = margin
        page.insert_text(
            (margin, y_pos + fontsize),
            line,
            fontsize=fontsize,
            fontname=fontname,
            color=color,
        )
        y_pos += fontsize + 2

    y_pos += spacing_after

pdf.save("/workspace/testbed/docs/customer_report.pdf")
pdf.close()
print("PDF created successfully")
'''
